arXiv:2601.19458v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Kitaev model is exactly solvable in terms of Majorana fermions hopping on a honeycomb lattice and coupled to a static Z₂ gauge field, giving the possibility of π-vortices in hexagonal plaquettes. In the vortex-full sector and in the presence of a time-reversal-breaking three-spin term of strength κ, the energy spectrum is gapped and the ground state possesses an even Chern number. An isolated vortex-free plaquette acts as a ``dual vortex'' and binds a fermionic mode at finite energy ϵ in the bulk gap. This mode is equivalent to two coupled Majorana zero modes located on the same dual vortex.
